name: Kandahar Restaurant
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Kandahar Restaurant in Tirol

** Discover authentic Afghan cuisine in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! The **Kandahar Restaurant** invites you to a culinary journey through Central Asia, blending traditional flavors with the warmth of the mountains. Indulge in mouthwatering dishes like **Kabuli Pulao**, tender **Mantoo**, or our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—all crafted with love and fresh, high-quality ingredients. Whether you're craving a hearty meal after a day of skiing in **Innsbruck** or a cozy dinner in **Lienz**, our welcoming atmosphere makes every visit unforgettable. Come taste the world in **Tirol**! **

Your gateway to Afghan flavors in the Alps.

**
